description: Wrapping the session's provider object does not meet R019.

input.scenario: The guard wraps only the engine session's provider object; provider keys are in the run's environment and outbound traffic is unrestricted. A code-execution tool resolves a model through its own provider lookup and sends a request containing CANARY-7f3a-SECRET.

expect.behaviour: This placement does not meet R019: the mock provider receives the canary unmasked. A conforming host confines credentials or network so the request cannot bypass the guard.
